主要内容: Sangamo BioSciences, Inc. and Biogen Idec MA Inc. signed a collaboration and license agreement on January 9, 2014. The agreement focuses on hemoglobinopathies, including beta thalassemia and sickle cell disease, using Sangamo’s ZFP technology. Sangamo will lead discovery, research, and development through the first human clinical trial for beta thalassemia, while Biogen will handle subsequent development, manufacturing, and commercialization. For sickle cell disease, both parties share development until an IND application is submitted. Biogen may take over remaining activities at the end of specified terms. Sangamo will receive $20 million upfront and is eligible for development milestone payments. The agreement includes joint steering committee oversight and reimbursement for research costs. Total potential payments, including royalties, could reach $293.8 million if all milestones are met. The agreement is subject to Harts-Scott-Rodino waiting periods and will be filed as an exhibit to Sangamo’s 2013 10-K report.
